purpose: Explicitly clear resident utterance-derived work/results while retaining validated immutable weights, vocabulary, allocations, GPU pipelines and decoder pool. Coder recognize defers clear after copying text, including thrown failure.

semantics.serialization: API lock then Metal lock, same order as encode; encode waits completed GPU commands before releasing Metal lock
semantics.cpu_wipe: Full allocated w32/w64/wave/features/encoded/last-snapshots and token/frame/draft/stats/text/info fields; has_result invalidated
semantics.gpu_wipe: Full allocated shared-buffer capacities1..3; weight0, loaded identity, module/kernel/allocations retained
semantics.implementation: Apple AnnexK memset_s; portable volatile-byte fallback. Compiler cannot elide explicit writes.

scope_limits: Caller-owned input/output is preserved, not erased. A returned transcript remains in its intended composer draft.
This clears live long-lived resident arenas, not all transient stack/register copies or OS/driver forensic remnants.
An in-flight immutable clip must remain until its bounded recognition call finishes; cancellation suppresses delivery immediately, then deferred clearing and buffer release finish after recognition.
No model arithmetic/storage reduction changes and no full29-corpus, whole-model CPU or legacy mutation run repeated.

cpu_private_effect.proof: Synthetic owned engine, all mutable regions poisoned then physically inspected zero, full tails, immutable weights/vocab unchanged, idempotence/invalid handles, public inspectors refuse without writes, caller bytes preserved.

gpu_buffer_effect.proof: Tiny injected shared-memory arena, guards around full capacities, weight0 and bound resources/loaded identity retained. No GPU/model arithmetic invoked.

actual_gpu.proof: Original pinned model opens once; clear before first use; known3.195sclip success→clear→sameclip success with identical expected text, same engine and decoder thread count; snapshots invalidated after each clear.
actual_gpu.expected_text: I am convinced of what I say, said the Count.

swift_defer.proof: Injected C ABI verifies successful returned text survives and resident clear executes exactly once both on success and thrown recognition failure. No device/model execution in this composition oracle.

sanitizers.unchanged_model_math: Previously qualified native objects reused unsanitized; changed C memory effects and their oracles are sanitized.

build_scope: Only changed C effect objects compiled; original Coax arithmetic/thread/Metal host objects reused. No Coax compiler or global budget changed. Canonical native archive/objects/executable installed by atomic rename after tests.

read_only_peer_review.result: no blocking omission or lock/lifetime issue found
read_only_peer_review.scope: Actual C clear implementation, full mutable-region inventory, Metal/API lock order and barriers, Swift copy-before-defer/failure cleanup, and documented ownership limitations. No extra test or source edit.
